updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.6.4 
- OpenKneeboard Out: added Navigraph EFB integration WIP.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added chart rotation and fit controls.
- OpenKneeboard Out: enhanced kneeboard EFB and FLT PLN UI behavior, presentation and controls.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added stylus-only radial chart search overlay with center token display and Back/Clear actions.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added previous and next hover icons for quick chart browsing.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: annimated search overlay motion to slide out from and retract back into the left rail/drawer flow.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: moved SA Map from FLT PLN into the EFB viewing area with preserved Navlog route rendering.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: integrated moving-map controls using EFB follow ownship, track-up, anchor, center-ownship, and layer toggles.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: added optional fast-ownship source toggle (GPS icon) for troubleshooting and legacy fallback switching.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: improved ownship rendering stability during refresh and layer changes to prevent heading/follow reset and icon strobing.
